The paper does report these win-rate evaluations, all judged by GPT-4 (gpt-4-0314, p. 20) unless noted:

- **Anthropic-HH single-turn dialogue (vs. chosen responses):** No single number is given in the text. Figure 3 shows DPO is the only method that improves over the chosen responses (pp. 8–9).
- **CNN/DailyMail out-of-distribution (vs. ground-truth summaries):** DPO scores 0.36 at temperature 0 and 0.31 at temperature 0.25. PPO scores 0.26 and 0.23 (Table 1, p. 9).

An AlpacaEval 2 result for DPO would have to come from a different source.
